verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents one-click templates, starter repos, or deploy buttons for common use cases. Blueprints (a single render.yaml defining an architecture) are an infrastructure-as-code building block, not ready-made templates. The ClickHouse page is a deployment guide, not a one-click starter, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases
